description.value: Everything Wine is a BC-based specialty wine and spirits retailer carrying a broad selection of wine by region, variety, and occasion, alongside beer, cider, and spirits. The Surrey location sits in a strip-mall unit and is part of a multi-store chain. Cyclists passing through could pick up wine, craft beer, or cider for the evening, though the store offers no on-site consumption.
